correctness.rationale: Directly used the cited signed-incidence normalized Laplacian: its coordinates are identical within each center or leaf block, hence cancel exactly from differences of pre-fold values even at arbitrarily large real coupling. The triangle folding is globally 1-Lipschitz and tent map is mu/2-Lipschitz, proving one-step and inductive global diameter estimates. At coupling 0 and small lower-branch initial coordinates rate equality persists at every iterate. For mu=2 all S_j balances zero imply Laplacian zero, tent and fold both identity inside the half-cube; the ell leaf-balance equations are independent and an interior balanced vector shows dimension d-ell. Perturbing coordinates within a nonsingleton block proves nonsynchronized fixed points. For coupling nonzero the local fixed equations reduce to Delta x=0. For 2<mu<=4 coupling zero admits distinct scalar fixed points 0 and mu/(mu+2). Independently checked balanced examples across 27 integer size combinations; analysis is not inferred from those finite cases.
